title: First trip abroad and sitting in at European clubs
summary: The Quincy Jones tour was Baker's first time out of the U.S.; he sat in at clubs and met Bud Powell and others.

story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: That tour with Quincy – was that the first time you had gone to Europe?
I can’t remember. I think it might have been. I don’t remember for sure if I had been to Europe before. That’s the first time I can remember going with a big band. It might have been the first time.
I was just wondering if there were any experiences your first time actually out of the U.S.?
Yeah, it was my first time out of the U.S. That was a great experience.
Gosh, I'm so glad. James Zimmerman: Did you fly?

Yeah. And fact is, I can remember Curtis and those cats would be drinking and reveling, and when the plane would take off, Curtis [would] say, “Don’t nobody be cussing when the plane’s taking off.” [laughter] And we'd get up in the air and then it would go back to real – everybody stopped drinking when the plane was taking off [laughter], which was kinda different. But I met a lot of people over there, and I got to play. I would sit in at the clubs. Bud Powell was over there at the time. So many – I can’t even remember the names. Clubs were jumping.
